name: Ethereum
label: ENERGY

payload_decoded.emissionsSource: MiCA WP S.14 0.00002 kgCO2e/tx; Crypto Risk Metrics GmbH; period to 2025-03-22; sha256:c316bb1cad63fc19

payload_abi: (string ledgerId, uint8 label, uint64 expiry, uint64 emissionsUg, string emissionsSource)
evidence_hash_rule: sha256 over the exact bytes of the evidence file minus its trailing newline (canonical JSON: sorted keys, no spaces, UTF-8)
notes: Provisional. The registry only accepts nonce == version + 1, so nonces must be renumbered against the live registry version at signing time; renumbering changes the digest.
Must satisfy effectiveFrom < expiry <= effectiveFrom + 366 days. Relaying before 2026-12-31 with a 7-day notice keeps this valid.
0 = as soon as the registry's CERT_NOTICE has passed after relay (effectiveFrom = max(effectiveAt, block.timestamp + CERT_NOTICE)).
Intensity basis - marginal: S.16 says the intensity is the marginal emission of one additional transaction; the spec's Greenest mode assumes an allocation (total / transactions)
